Package com.example.allot.model

Class User

java.lang.Object
com.example.allot.model.User
public class User extends Object
Represents a user in the application, including profile information, event history, created events, and saved events.

    • User

      public User(String deviceId, String firstname, String lastName, String email, String phone, String role)
      Creates a user with the provided profile information.
      Parameters:
      deviceId - the unique device ID for the user
      firstname - the user's first name
      lastName - the user's last name
      email - the user's email address
      phone - the user's phone number
      role - the user's role in the application
